ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the financial document:  3i Infotech reported modest 4.1% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27 to ₹182.0 crore. While headline profitability (EBITDA, PAT) shows a YoY decline, this is materially impacted by a non-recurring income in the prior year, indicating an underlying improvement in operational performance. The company is strategically repositioning with new business units (DES, CISS, BPS), securing 25 new clients, and substantial order bookings (TCV ₹467.3 Cr) to fuel future capability-led growth.
